adaptation.mechanism: live-only capability-narrowed resource leases with canonical logical hierarchical claims, read/write collision detection, expiry, monotonic fencing, and in-flight holds that prevent close/reap from releasing claims before operation quiescence

hardening: uses exact integer nanosecond time supplied by caller rather than float wall-clock policy
resource keys are logical caller-canonicalized namespaced hierarchies, not filesystem paths
noncanonical aliases with empty, dot, dot-dot, repeated, or trailing hierarchy segments fail closed
lease close fails busy while an operation hold is active; expiry reaping preserves held claims so conflicting work cannot enter early
protected_effect_authority and persistence claim-ceiling fields are non-init constants and cannot be supplied by ordinary construction
excluded_claims: resource lease is durable task ownership
resource claim canonicalizes or validates filesystem paths
VeraMesh session authentication or transport is installed
VeraPort lane runtime is copied wholesale
